label: The Apocalypse of John addresses the church at Ephesus

date.note: Composition of the Apocalypse: the dominant Domitianic dating (c. 95, per Irenaeus, Haer. 5.30.3) as upper bound, the minority Neronian dating as lower.

secondary.cite: Harnack, Mission and Expansion, vol. 2, pp. 185–186

notes: One of the seven churches of Apoc. 2–3. Harnack counts Ephesus among the communities attested before Trajan's reign.
